scope: LLMRig staging only; no Android installation or rival acceptance

Overture.identity: GERS UUID; original provider record IDs, property provenance, licenses and versions retained
Overture.eligibility: all named valid point records with a UUID; no country or confidence cutoff
Overture.dedup: distinct source IDs and exact normalized name/coordinate/category groups; near-duplicate identity remains unresolved
Overture.live_status: unknown; operating_status is a dated source snapshot
Overture.rights: per-source CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Apache-2.0, CC0 or unknown as recorded; distribution review pending
Overture.coordinate_accuracy: source-provided WKB point; finite/range validity checked; real-world accuracy not independently established
Overture.audit_entity_key: 128-bit prefix of SHA-256 over normalized name, exact float hex coordinates and category; source ID set comparison is exact over UUID bytes; semantic uniqueness unknown
Overture.normalization: Unicode NFKC, case folding, whitespace collapse; original names remain unchanged in record JSON

OpenStreetMap.selection: every node, way and relation with diet:vegan, diet:vegetarian or opening_hours
OpenStreetMap.geometry: exact source node coordinates; complete-way referenced-node bounding-box centers with explicit antimeridian wrap metadata; relation coordinates unknown and retained
OpenStreetMap.identity: object type, integer ID, version, timestamp and pinned snapshot hash
OpenStreetMap.semantics: yes/only tags qualify dietary search; absent tags are unknown; hours strings are never evaluated as live opening status
OpenStreetMap.rights: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0; separate database; distribution obligations remain
OpenStreetMap.raw_codec: Selected schema 2: zlib UTF-8 JSON arrays [latitude,longitude,complete original source object]; shared planet hash in snapshot/metadata; preserved row-format derivation evidence remains outside installed assets

GeoNames.identity: GeoNames integer ID plus exact downloaded SHA-256 and per-record modified date
GeoNames.selection: every cities500 row and supplied aliases; not every settlement
GeoNames.semantics: ambiguous aliases retain multiple cities; source localities do not imply administrative containment
GeoNames.provenance_location: original row and modified date in city table; acquisition hash/date/license in accompanying immutable report and source receipt
GeoNames.alias_query_limit: up to 100 candidates sorted by population, with all rows retained in the asset

Wikivoyage.format: full pages-articles XML, all namespaces, original compressed wikitext
Wikivoyage.identity: page ID, revision ID, timestamp, original SHA1 and pinned dump SHA-256
Wikivoyage.listings: literal listing templates with nested-field handling, original template retained; no template execution
Wikivoyage.supplement: full English 2026-09 Kiwix ZIM reused read-only; original compressed HTML retained; missing revision/license fields stay unknown
Wikivoyage.counts: listing occurrences are not unique places; XML and ZIM overlap and are not added as independent coverage
Wikivoyage.rights: Wikivoyage contributors, CC-BY-SA-4.0 with revision/history links and page-specific exceptions; no inferred media rights
Wikivoyage.retention: official full XML database primary; ZIM-derived database optional measured staging supplement; no counts summed

reader_contract.places: 16 standard SQLite shards: metadata, block, grid, category, city, rejected; 0.1-degree grid; exact WGS84 point doubles
reader_contract.source_details: zlib UTF-8 JSON arrays [1-based original ordinal,latitude,longitude,normalized name,full original nongeometry record]; block SHA-256 verified
reader_contract.query_bounds: 0 < radius km <= 100; limit 1..100; exact Haversine; antimeridian and poles; source snapshot only
reader_contract.python: compact_search.py, enrich.py, catalog.py; multi-shard exact grouping, city aliases and separate explicit-tag dietary search
reader_contract.android: CompactPlaces.java per-shard radius/category/source and OsmPlaces.java explicit dietary radius/source readers; API35 compilation only; no app integration, multi-shard runtime or physical acceptance
reader_contract.admission: verify sealed file hashes, storage and actual phone resources before read-only use
reader_contract.legacy: schema1 row staging and OfflinePlaces.java retained as historical measured budget failure
reader_contract.group_conflicts: compact_search.group_sources and Catalog.source_variants yield every retained exact-group variant, including conflicting fields
reader_contract.osm_enrichment: Catalog.nearby attaches all exact-normalized-name candidates within 50m with unconfirmed identity labels; explicit dietary search uses separate OSM source objects
reader_contract.travel: exact title/revision lookup, full original wikitext, and bounded literal-coordinate nearby listings; no template expansion or unique-place inference
reader_contract.osm: osm-compact.sqlite: metadata, snapshot, block(id,records,payload,sha256), osm(type,id,name_key,lat,lon,vegan,vegetarian,block,slot); type/id primary key; partial name/spatial and positive-diet spatial indexes; full source JSON retains tags, references and version/timestamp
